aboutGame.title: What is Legion Breaker?
paragraphs: Legion Breaker is an active incremental defense game from indie developer Baffled Engineer, published by Level Up Gaming and Gamersky Games. You control a lone battlemage holding a line against endless undead legions, aiming spell projectiles toward your cursor while a growing holy army of spearmen and archers fights alongside you.

Every run blends real-time aiming with a deep Gold-fueled upgrade tree split across Spellcraft, Sustain, Martial Forces, and Economy. A constant Blight Damage drain turns each battle into a race for kills, so balancing explosive area-of-effect magic, Spirit Drain recovery, and unit synergy is the key to toppling the Necromancer King.

modules.name: Legion Breaker Beginner Guide
modules.description: This module provides new players with essential gameplay basics, including how to start as a wizard, defeat undead enemies, earn gold, and progress efficiently. It helps beginners understand core systems before exploring advanced builds.

highlights.detail: Start each run as a lone battlemage and aim your primary spell projectiles toward the cursor to burst down skeletal soldiers before they close in.
Counter the constant Blight Damage health drain by killing fast, because every enemy death triggers Spirit Drain and restores a chunk of your health bar.
Invest early Gold into Fortitude to raise your maximum HP, giving you a wider survival window during the first undead waves.
Unlock the Oathsworn Guard spearmen to body-block swarms, then add Temple Huntsmen archers for off-screen single-target and air coverage.
Layer area-of-effect upgrades such as Fireball so a single cast detonates packed clusters instead of ticking one target at a time.
Bank Gold before each boss gate, then dump it into core damage and sustain nodes to survive the tougher phase transitions.

modules.name: Legion Breaker Spells Guide
modules.description: This section covers the spell system, including available magic abilities, upgrade paths, and strategies for combining elemental and arcane attacks. Players can learn which spells are useful for different battle situations.

highlights.label: Fireball
highlights.detail: Explosive area-of-effect upgrade that turns isolated impacts into wide detonations against packed undead hordes.

highlights.label: Fragments
highlights.detail: Resounding Fragments I through III shatter primary hits into bouncing shards that chain across an entire advance squad.

highlights.label: Arcane
highlights.detail: Base projectile impact and explosion radius scaling that carries your burst damage against armored skeletons.

highlights.label: Flare
highlights.detail: Solar Flare is a long-cooldown burst spell whose stun interrupts and staggers heavy boss attacks.

highlights.label: Aim Lead
highlights.detail: Fire slightly ahead of moving targets so fast runners and ghouls walk straight into your projectile path.

highlights.label: Splash
highlights.detail: Prioritize splash radius upgrades to clear clumps faster and keep your kill momentum high through every wave.

modules.name: Legion Breaker Skill Tree Guide
modules.description: This module explains the skill tree progression system, upgrade choices, and ways to improve damage, attack speed, and overall combat power. It helps players plan stronger builds during the campaign.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Arcane Offense spell damage, cast rhythm, and projectile splitting carry both horde clearing and boss burst damage.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Vital Preservation maximum HP and life recovery directly counter the relentless Blight Damage drain.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Martial Bastion spearmen and archer summons add passive lane control and hands-free damage.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Bounty and Economy gold-per-kill nodes speed up scaling but rarely decide a fight on their own.

modules.name: Legion Breaker Army Guide
modules.description: This section focuses on recruiting and upgrading the holy army that fights alongside the wizard. It explains troop progression and how to combine units with spells for stronger battlefield performance.

highlights.label: Spearmen
highlights.detail: Oathsworn Guard frontline units body-block swarms and stop undead from leaking through your defensive perimeter.

highlights.label: Archers
highlights.detail: Temple Huntsmen deliver long-range single-target salvos, picking off fast runners, backline casters, and air units.

highlights.label: Vanguard
highlights.detail: Auxiliary Vanguard troops stagger armored juggernauts and charging brutes before they ever reach your wizard.

highlights.label: Frontline
highlights.detail: Keep melee units parked at the choke point so your battlemage can cast safely from a pocket behind them.

highlights.label: Backline
highlights.detail: Pair archers with a tanky front line, because undefended ranged units get overrun the moment a wave breaks through.

highlights.label: Gold Cost
highlights.detail: Fielding a large army is expensive, so budget unit summons against your spell upgrade spending each run.

modules.name: Legion Breaker Boss Guide
modules.description: This module provides information about battlefield bosses, enemy challenges, and recommended strategies for defeating stronger undead forces. It targets players searching for boss-related progression help.

highlights.label: Commander
highlights.detail: Early undead commanders telegraph heavy cleaves, so bait the wind-up and then reposition your front line.

highlights.label: Necro King
highlights.detail: The Necromancer King is the campaign's final test, escalating through phases with faster attacks and extra minions.

highlights.label: Phase 1
highlights.detail: Open with sustained single-target burst while your holy army holds the line and soaks the first wave.

highlights.label: Phase 2
highlights.detail: Cleave damage ramps up, so pull fragile auxiliary units back and refresh your front-line summons.

highlights.label: Final Burn
highlights.detail: Chain crowd-control and Solar Flare stuns, then burn the boss before the next minion wave spawns.

highlights.label: Crescent
highlights.detail: Use the Crescent Anchor formation to physically block the boss from closing on your wizard's casting perimeter.

modules.name: Legion Breaker Upgrade Guide
modules.description: This section explains gold usage, upgrade priorities, and progression decisions that help players maximize their power growth. It is designed for players looking for efficient upgrade routes.

highlights.label: Damage
highlights.detail: Buy core spell damage and explosion radius first so early waves die in one or two hits instead of lingering.

highlights.label: Fortitude
highlights.detail: Raise maximum HP early to widen your survival window against the relentless Blight Damage drain.

highlights.label: Drain
highlights.detail: Stack Spirit Drain so every kill returns more health and offsets the passive degeneration.

highlights.label: Summons
highlights.detail: Fund unit upgrades once your own spell damage can comfortably clear baseline undead waves.

highlights.label: Economy
highlights.detail: Gold-per-kill nodes compound over a run and pay for themselves by the mid game.

highlights.label: Priority
highlights.detail: Spend in bursts bank Gold before boss gates instead of spreading it thin across fringe utility perks.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Legion Breaker.

items.question: What is Legion Breaker?
items.answer: Legion Breaker is an active incremental defense game from developer Baffled Engineer, published by Level Up Gaming and Gamersky Games. You control a lone battlemage who aims spells at endless undead waves while commanding a growing holy army of spearmen and archers.

items.question: Is Legion Breaker free to play?
items.answer: No. Legion Breaker is a paid PC title on Steam priced at $6.99, with a 20% introductory discount that drops it to $5.59 through late October. A free demo is also available.

items.question: How long does a Legion Breaker run take?
items.answer: A full Legion Breaker campaign run lasts roughly 30 to 60 minutes across three escalating boss battles, though faster clears are possible once you know the upgrade priorities.

items.question: What is Blight Damage in Legion Breaker?
items.answer: Blight Damage is a constant passive health drain that ticks from the moment a battle starts. It acts as a combat timer in Legion Breaker, so kill fast and lean on Spirit Drain recovery to stay alive.

items.question: Which upgrades should beginners buy first in Legion Breaker?
items.answer: Prioritize core spell damage and Fortitude for maximum HP, then Spirit Drain for sustain. In Legion Breaker, spreading gold across fringe utility perks early usually leaves your damage too low for the first boss.

items.question: Does Legion Breaker have codes?
items.answer: Legion Breaker is a paid single-player PC game with no redemption codes. Progression comes from gold earned in battle and the in-run upgrade tree rather than code rewards.

items.question: What platforms is Legion Breaker on?
items.answer: Legion Breaker is available on PC via Steam. There is currently no console or mobile version of Legion Breaker.
